{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
print("Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE severity patients:", len(control_moderate))

# Check response rate
print("Number who responded:", control_moderate['responded'].sum())
print("Total number:", len(control_moderate))

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()

fraction_responded"}
